column8: ["The teal seats have bright lower-right rims and heavy upper-left interiors, making them read as tilted cups under directional light rather than straight-down forms.","The reddish collars and brown struts read as muddy bands rather than rubbed brass and worn rubber, leaving the material palette thin.","The seat glazes look mottled and sooty toward their centres; keep their colour clean and gather wear at contact edges."]
